statements.status_notes: Fixed upstream in glob 13.0.7: the v13.0.7 release includes the backport of the upstream fix commit "fix: do not continue walking after signal abort" (https://github.com/isaacs/node-glob/commit/d94a8c8d0a89b89436d9612ebea6f9995104e05e). DHI bundles glob 13.0.7 in its npm 11 and npm 12 packages. Scanners that track the fixed version as 14.0.2 still flag glob 13.0.7.

Fixed upstream in glob 13.0.7: the v13.0.7 release includes the backport of the upstream fix commit "fix: do not continue walking after signal abort" (https://github.com/isaacs/node-glob/commit/d94a8c8d0a89b89436d9612ebea6f9995104e05e). DHI bundles glob 13.0.7 in its npm 11 and npm 12 packages. Scanners that track the fixed version as 14.0.2 still flag glob 13.0.7.

The fixed release is glob 14.0.2, a major version jump from 11.1.0; no 11.x release contains the fix. In this image the vulnerable copy is bundled only in the assistantDashboards plugin node_modules tree. Moving it across the major version has not been adopted yet, so this finding remains open until that plugin tree can take a validated 14.x line.

GitHub advisory and Scout document CVE-2026-118773 for npm glob versions from 9.0.0 through 14.0.1, with fixed releases on the 14.0.2 line. The Vault 2.2.x UI lockfile still resolves glob 9.x and 10.x for Ember tooling; moving all consumers to glob 14.0.2 is a multi-major override that must be validated separately from this CVE line.
